preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(0 <= pi <= i for i, pi in enumerate(p))
preconditions.description: The list p must have n-1 elements, and each element pi must be between 0 and i.

preconditions.expression: len(x) == n and all(xi in {0, 1} for xi in x)
preconditions.description: The list x must have n elements, and each element xi must be either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of ways to split the tree modulo 1000000007.
